prose: Cory Doctorow plugs Lindsay Owens's new book Gouged, a guide to surveillance pricing and algorithmic wage discrimination - using computers and commercial surveillance data to pick pockets and shrink paychecks. Owens runs Groundwork Collaborative, whose fellow Katie Wells co-authored the report showing how nursing shiftwork apps collude with data brokers to learn nurses' credit-card debt so the most desperate can be offered lower wages. Doctorow presents the book as the accessible, comprehensive reference on a modern scourge that makes 'the worst people on earth far richer.'
highlights: Subject: surveillance pricing and algorithmic wage discrimination
Groundwork exposed nursing apps using credit-card debt data to underpay desperate nurses
Doctorow calls it a comprehensive, accessible guide to the practice
Frames the pattern as corporate power plus surveillance data picking pockets
quotes: using computers to spy on you to rip you off
